proposals.title: Backup GPT fallback only fires on CRC mismatch, not on primary signature corruption

current_state.spec: FR-003 / US2 scenario 2: if the primary header is corrupt, the backup MUST be attempted.
current_state.code: read_gpt (src/gpt.rs) falls through to backup only on CorruptTable (CRC). A bad/zeroed primary signature returns NoPartitionTable and is propagated; initialize_or_format then reformats a disk whose backup is still valid (data loss).

proposals.proposed_resolution: Draft fix: in read_gpt, fall through to the backup attempt on NoPartitionTable as well as CorruptTable.
proposals.verification: cargo build -p disk-partition-manager clean. No unit tests exist; backup-signature-recovery test queued in align-tasks.md.
proposals.outcome: Fix drafted on branch; FR-003 spec text clarified + noted.

proposals.title: Read performs ~33 round-trips (per-sector) vs the stated 'at most 2'

current_state.spec: PR-002: initialize read requires at most 2 I/O round-trips.
current_state.code: read_bytes loops one ReadSync per sector; 16 KiB entry array = 32 round-trips @512B (4 @4096B) + 1 header.

proposals.proposed_resolution: Backfill PR-002 to describe per-sector reads; reframe as O(1) in device size; note batching as a future perf task.

proposals.requirement: Unspecced: hardcoded LBA 2 read; generate_guid zero-fallback; FR-011 sector-size validation
proposals.title: Document low-severity behaviors in spec

current_state.code: Read hardcodes entry LBA 2 instead of parsed partition_entry_lba; generate_guid returns near-zero GUID if /dev/urandom fails; no explicit 512/4096 sector-size validation.

proposals.proposed_resolution: Document all three in Implementation Notes (and FR-008/FR-011 context). No code change.
